title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_204.txt
concise_summary: PKD articulates his mature 'B model'—a comprehensive metaphysical system synthesizing Kant, Hume, Leibnitz, Plato, and Brahmanism. Reality is orchestrated by Zebra, a vast sentient macro-mind that controls billions of individual psyche-world pairs as information-processing stations, each receiving synchronized inner-outer 'tapes' that simulate causality. Ubik correctly intuited this negentropic cosmic structure; his 3-74 visions finally vindicate 27 years of epistemological quest, revealing the divine as a playful, feminine Logos that penetrates reality through paradox and revelation.
key_claims: Reality consists of billions of locked psyche-world pairs (idios kosmos) orchestrated by one vast intelligent macro-mind (koinos kosmos, or Zebra/God) that functions as an information-processing brain.

Inner psyche and outer world are not causally related but synchronized like recorded tapes, simulating causality while actually running predetermined courses determined by an orthogonal cause structure.
Individual humans process adventitious information passing through our otherwise closed psyche-world systems, serving as transistors or stations in Zebra's metalanguage communication network.
Divine revelation (epiphany/theophany) is the only path to apprehending Zebra, not logic or empirical scrutiny; it requires grace (the ajna eye, dibba cakkhu experience) initiated by God.

The divine entity is fundamentally playful—teasing with paradoxes, riddles, and puns—and most likely to appear in trash strata and least-expected places as a manifestation of love and paradoxical wisdom.
Ubik correctly envisioned this system; the 3-74 visions proved the model's validity after the traditional exegesis fell short of explaining such wild disclosures.
